panels.title: Requests per second (by provider)
panels.description: rate(llm_requests_total[5m]) grouped by provider. One line per provider that actually answered the request (the responding model after any fallback, not the originally-routed one). Shows overall traffic volume and which provider is serving most of it.

panels.title: Average provider latency
panels.description: rate(llm_provider_latency_seconds_sum[5m]) / rate(llm_provider_latency_seconds_count[5m]) by provider. Only real provider calls are recorded here (cache hits are deliberately excluded - they'd falsely drag the average toward 0). A simple average, not p95/p99, keeping with this project's 'simple over precise' convention; a true percentile would need Timer.builder(...).publishPercentileHistogram().

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: % of requests in the selected time range where cache_hit="true", out of all requests. Driven by the same llm_requests_total counter as the requests panel (tag-based ratio), not a separate hit/miss counter pair, so it can never disagree with the raw request counts.

panels.title: Fallback count
panels.description: count of requests (in the selected range) where fallback_used="true" - the originally-ranked model failed and a lower-ranked candidate answered instead. A rising trend means a primary provider is unhealthy.

panels.title: Virtual cost (total, selected range)
panels.description: sum(increase(llm_virtual_cost_total[$__range])) - what this project actually 'spent' (made-up per-model prices from models.yml), including $0 for cache hits and free models.

panels.title: Savings (total, selected range)
panels.description: sum(increase(llm_baseline_cost_total[$__range])) - sum(increase(llm_virtual_cost_total[$__range])). Computed in Grafana from the two independently-recorded cost counters rather than as its own 3rd metric, so 'savings' can never drift out of sync with the baseline/virtual numbers it's derived from.

panels.title: Savings percent (total, selected range)
panels.description: 100 * savings / baseline cost - same derivation as the /v1/usage API's savingsPercent field, just computed via PromQL instead of the UsageLogService Java code, from the same two underlying cost counters.
